mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth by more than 1% over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
